entries.title: Psalms 72:1
segments: A Psalm of Solomon. Give the King Your judgments, O God, and Your righteousness to the King's son.

entries.title: Psalms 72:2
segments: He will judge Your people in righteousness, and Your poor with judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 72:3
segments: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills by righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 72:4
segments: He shall judge the poor of the people; He shall save the children of the needy, and shall crush in pieces the cruel one.

entries.title: Psalms 72:5
segments: They shall fear You [as long as] the sun and moon [endure], throughout all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 72:6
segments: He shall come down like rain on the mown grass, like showers [that] water the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:7
segments: In His days the righteous shall flourish; and abundance of peace, until the moon [is] not.

entries.title: Psalms 72:8
segments: He shall also have the rule from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:9
segments: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before Him; and His enemies shall lick the dust.

entries.title: Psalms 72:10
segments: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents; the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

entries.title: Psalms 72:11
segments: Yes, all kings shall fall down before Him; all nations shall serve Him.

entries.title: Psalms 72:12
segments: For He shall deliver the needy when he cries; and the poor [with] no helper.

entries.title: Psalms 72:13
segments: He shall have pity on the poor and needy and shall save the souls of the needy.

entries.title: Psalms 72:14
segments: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence; and their blood shall be precious in His sight.

entries.title: Psalms 72:15
segments: And He shall live, and to Him shall be given the gold of Sheba; and prayer shall always be made for Him; He shall bless Him all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 72:16
segments: There shall be a fullness of grain in the earth on the top of the mountains; its fruit shall shake like Lebanon, and [they] of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 72:17
segments: His name shall endure forever; His name shall be continued as long as the sun; and [men] shall be blessed in Him; all nations shall call Him blessed.

entries.title: Psalms 72:18
segments: Blessed [is] the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does wonderful things.

entries.title: Psalms 72:19
segments: And blessed [be] His glorious name forever; and all the earth is filled [with] His glory! Amen and Amen.

entries.title: Psalms 72:20
segments: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
